init.title: Projector status refresh
init.description: Choose how often to refresh input, signal, and optional picture settings while the projector is fully on. Normal refresh pauses during fast power-transition monitoring.

data_description.operational_refresh_interval: Changes apply immediately. Disabled stops periodic input, signal, and picture-setting checks, but not SDAP or power monitoring.
data_description.refresh_picture_settings: Refresh supported, enabled picture controls at the same interval: picture mode, sharpness, brightness, contrast, light output, Reality Creation, and video mute. Off keeps input and signal refresh only.
